QuestInfo.name: [Lion King's Castle] Alcaster's Crystal
QuestInfo.0: Alcaster says he has a favor to ask of you regarding #p2161004#.
QuestInfo.1: Alcaster has placed his magic power in the Crystal to release #p2161004#'s curse. Alcaster claims that using this Crystal near #p2161004# will break the curse of the Lion King. Go to where #p2161004# is and use Alcaster's Crystal.
QuestInfo.2: You have freed #p2161004# from the Lion King's curse! #p2161004#, as a token of his gratitude, says he will give you armor and a weapon he found in the castle in exchange for #b#t4310010##k.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
EXP 682,200
* Can purchase the #bVon Leon Set#k.
